summary: This unit covers the Djuma, Lusanga and Pay Kongila secteurs of Bulungu territory (Kwilu), a rural area between the Kwilu river and Kikwit including the Kwenge, Lusanga, Djuma and Vanga health zones. No armed group is known to exercise territorial control here; the Mobondo militia that spread from Kwamouth into Kwilu since 2022 has affected mainly western Bagata territory. All localities are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as main permanent force, supported by territorial administration and customary chiefs. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, sources blocked), so confidence is low for rural villages.

zones.description: Main centres of the unit (pop. >10,000): Bivac and Kwenge (Kwenge health areas, Pay Kongila), Carrefour/Kwanga and Kakoy (Lusanga health zone), Cdr (Djuma mission centre)
zones.evidence: Larger trading/mission centres in Bulungu territory (Kwilu) with PNC posts, secteur administration and customary chiefs; no armed group is reported to hold or regularly operate in these localities. The Mobondo militia's spillover into Kwilu has concerned western Bagata territory, not this eastern part of Bulungu. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region.

zones.description: Rural villages of Djuma secteur (Djuma and Vanga health zones, plus a Bulungu-HZ locality), along the Kwilu/Inzia west of Bulungu
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group activity located for Djuma secteur villages; ordinary state authority via PNC posts, secteur administration and customary chiefs is assumed. Bagata territory to the west is the nearest Mobondo-affected area, but no incursions into Djuma secteur are known. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region.

zones.description: Rural villages of Lusanga and Pay Kongila secteurs (Lusanga, Bulungu, Mosango and Kikwit health zones) between Bulungu and Kikwit
zones.evidence: Area between Bulungu town and Kikwit, far from the Mobondo theatre in Kwamouth/western Bagata; no armed-group control reported. State authority through PNC posts and customary chiefs assumed. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region.
